items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Tommy Ladner, he said, learned from him over there in the band. Yeah. Did you know Tommy Ladner? He left here when he was real young. I guess you didn't know him much.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to stay over there. I know he used to teach the band. A whole lot of, he learned a whole lot of fellas. Band. Yeah. He had a good band, too.

I know Tommy Ladner, he said, learned from him over there in the band. Yeah. Did you know Tommy Ladner? He left here when he was real young. I guess you didn't know him much. Went to Chicago and played a lot up there. Where did he play?
